name: react-native-unified-plugins
description: React Native plugins for the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Unified Mobile SDK
author: Salesforce Marketing Cloud

scripts.lint:ios: swiftformat --lint packages/*/ios && find packages -type f \( -name '*.h' -o -name '*.m' -o -name '*.mm' \) -path '*/ios/*' -not -path '*/Pods/*' -not -path '*/build/*' -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format --dry-run --Werror
scripts.lint:native: yarn check:native-tools && yarn lint:android && yarn lint:ios
scripts.format:ios: swiftformat packages/*/ios && find packages -type f \( -name '*.h' -o -name '*.m' -o -name '*.mm' \) -path '*/ios/*' -not -path '*/Pods/*' -not -path '*/build/*' -print0 | xargs -0 clang-format -i
